LA VERNE’S
  ENHANCED INFRASTRUCTURE FINANCING DISTRICT
  PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  Tuesday, October 15, 2024, 8:00 a.m.
  3660 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
  City Council Chambers

Written comments will be accepted via email at Cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org. They will be shared with
the Authority Members prior to the meeting and will be made part of the permanent record.
We ask that you provide those emails before 7:00 p.m. the day before the meeting. Please be
advised that public comments submitted by emails or any other format to the City are public
records that will be made available for public viewing.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk's Office at
(909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

BOARD MEMBERS:  Mayor Tim Hepburn, Chair, Elected Member
  Councilmember Rick Crosby, Vice-Chair, Elected Member
  Supervisor Hilda Solis, Elected Member (Alt: Andrea Moreno)
  Dr. Anthony Orlando, Member of the Public (County)
  Wayne Hurley, Member of the Public, (City)

STAFF  Ken Domer, Executive Director
  Kimberly Hall Barlow, City Attorney
  Meg McWade, Public Works Director
  Eric Scherer, Community Development Director
  Debra Fritz, Deputy City Clerk

1.  Minutes of Public Financing Authority (EIFD) for the meeting of June 12, 2024.

  Recommendation:  That the Public Financing Authority approve the minutes.

 2.  Development Update – Verbal update.

  Recommendation:  This item is information only. No action is required by the Board.

3.  A Line (Former Gold (L) Line) / Pedestrian Bridge - Project Update - Verbal update.
 City of La Verne Public Financing Authority - EIFD Regular Meeting, Tuesday, October 15, 2024

  Recommendation:  This item is information only. No action is required by the Board.

4.  Consultant Study – 2024 Fiscal Impact Analysis – Preliminary Numbers

  Recommendation:  This item is information only. No action is required by the Board.

5.  EIFD Administrative Budget – Verbal update.

  Recommendation:  This item is information only. No action is required by the Board.

6.  Board / Staff Comments

  Recommendation:  This is the time set aside for Board and/or Staff comments.

PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to
address the Public Financing Authority on items not listed in any other place on the agenda. Under the
provisions of the Brown Act, the legislative body is prohibited from talking or engaging in discussion on
any item not appearing on the posted agenda. However, your concerns may be referred to staff or set
for discussion later. The Chair reserves the right to place limits on the duration of comments.

ADJOURNMENT - The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Public Financing Authority will be held
on Wednesday, December 11, 2024, at 9:00 a.m.

 Posting Statement: On October 10, 2024, a true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted at
 La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, CA and on the City’s website @cityoflaverne.org.

  2
   LA VERNE’S
  ENHANCED INFRASTRUCTURE FINANCING DISTRICT
  PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
  REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
  ACTION MINUTES
  “see items in italics”

  Wednesday, June 12, 2024, 9:00 a.m.
  3660 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
  Large Conference Room

CALL TO ORDER: The meeting was called to order at 9:06 a.m.

BOARD MEMBERS: Present  Tamela Omoto-Frias-Alt for Supervisor Hilda Solis
  Dr. Anthony Orlando, Member of the Public (County)
  Wayne Hurley, Member of the Public, (City)

BOARD MEMBERS: Absent  Mayor Tim Hepburn, Chairperson, Elected Member
  Council Member Rick Crosby, Vice-Chair,
  Elected Member

STAFF: Present  Ken Domer, City Manager
  Meg McWade, Public Works Director
  Eric Scherer, Director of Community Development
  Debra Fritz, Deputy City Clerk

1.  Minutes of Public Financing Authority (EIFD) for the meeting of December 13, 2023.

  Recommendation:  That the Public Financing Authority approve the minutes.

  It was moved by Hurley and seconded by Orlando to approve the minutes with revisions.

2.  Public Hearing – Annual Report - Per State law, the Public Financing Authority is required to
  provide an annual report of activities undertaken within the last year.

  Recommendation:  That the Public Financing Authority board conduct a Public Hearing on
  the “2023-2024 Annual Report of the City of La Verne Public Financing Authority (Authority) for
  the Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District,” taking any written or verbal testimony, and then
  adopt PFA Resolution No. 24-01, adopting the Annual Report for the EIFD for Fiscal Year 2023-
  2024.

  Public Works Director Meg McWade presented the annual report of activities undertaken
   within the last year. Having received no public testimony either verbal or written, it was
  moved by Orlando and seconded by Hurley to approve PFA Resolution No. 24-01, adopting
  the Annual Report for the EIFD Fiscal Year 2023-2024.

3.  Development Update - Verbal update.

  Recommendation:  This item is information only. No action is required by the Board

  Community Development Director Eric Scherer provided a verbal information only update.
  No action was required by the Board.

4.  A Line (Former Gold (L) Line) / Project Update - Verbal update.

  Recommendation:  This item is information only. No action is required by the Board.

  Public Works Director Meg McWade provided a verbal information only update. No action
  was required by the Board.

5.  Consultant Study – 2024 Fiscal Impact Analysis

  Recommendation:  This item is information only. No action is required by the Board.

  Community Development Director Eric Scherer provided this verbal, information only
  update. The study would be completed by consultant, Kosmont Companies, with
  information provided at a future date. No action was required by the Board.

6.  Board / Staff Comments - This is the time set aside for Board and/or Staff comments.

  There were no comments from the Board.

PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to
address the Public Financing Authority on items not listed in any other place on the agenda. Under the
provisions of the Brown Act, the legislative body is prohibited from talking or engaging in discussion on
any item not appearing on the posted agenda. However, your concerns may be referred to staff or set
for discussion later. The Chair reserves the right to place limits on the duration of comments.

There were no public comments received.

ADJOURNMENT -The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Public Financing Authority will be
held on Wednesday, September 11, 2024, at 9:00 a.m.

The meeting was adjourned at 9:54 a.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Debra Fritz
Deputy City Clerk
